stale_approvals.reason: T-148: OpenEV's Elroq 'Base' row (77 kWh, i.e. the Elroq 85, but with 150 kW) carried the NL list price 42005 and the used-price model of RDW Elroq 60 records (RDW 'ELROQ 60 150 kW 2026', catalogue price 42005), placed there by power. PR #167 adds seed rows Elroq 50 / 60 (Skoda technical data, 5 May 2025: 60 = 150 kW), so those records now sit on the 60 row and Base's price and used prices clear. A correction, not a loss. Measured: ev verify main vs PR #167 on the same staging (2026-11-18), 2 blocking, both this variant.

T-161: Decision 088 trim-line rule. The row's newest-version / older-version flag changes because versions are now compared within the same model + drivetrain + power line (> 15 % power starts a new line; unknown drivetrain or power = never compared), not model-wide. Measured: main vs T-161 built with their own code on one staging (2026-11-19): 48 blocking band lines on these 17 ids, 0 catalogue changes.

T-162: OpenEV's MY2025 Base file carried 185 kW (the Elroq RS figure); both official Škoda Auto Elroq Technical Data sheets (5 May 2025 and 15 Dec 2025, cdn.skoda-storyboard.com) state 135 kW max DC and 28 min (10-80 %) for the Elroq 85 RWD. Replacing the lone OpenEV peak with Škoda's cited manual facts (135 kW, 28 min) drops dc_peak_kw 185 -> 135, clears the synthetic default curve fields (dc_curve_status, dc_peak_held_min) now that the maker 10-80 time is explicit, and moves scores.road-tripper.urban.band shortlist -> consider (53.8 -> 51.4). Measured: ev verify --base-release-from origin/main on 2026-11-26 staging (4 blocking lines, all below); 0 blocking against published release 3.

T-166: Kia EV9 gen1 GT (F6E54 / F7E54, 220 km/h, WLTP 518 km) is split in match/tgk_split.yaml from 2025+ AWD (F6E34 / F7E24 / F7E34) and RWD (F7E12) versions whose shared trade name 'EV9 / EV9 GT' previously pulled 17 7-seat non-GT records onto kia-ev9-gen1-gt. With only the 6 real GT versions (3x F6E54 6-seat + 3x F7E54 7-seat), seats moves 7 -> 6 while WLTP stops carrying 17 conflicting values (510 -> 518 km), consumption moves 22.0 -> 20.8 kWh/100 km, and mass moves 2664 -> 2718 kg. Measured: ev verify --base-release-from origin/main on 2026-11-27 staging (1 blocking line, this entry); 0 T-166 blocking lines against published release 3.

top40.rule: a model takes the best level a majority of its release variants reach (2+ agreeing outside sources > 1 source > estimate or seed-manual only > none); a model not in the release is none. Registrations: number of sources with a count per country (periods differ, so 'sources present', not 'agreeing').

wltp_range_km.could_fill: openev, ademe (FR line-up), rdw fuel table (adapter live, Q-068), eea per type (adapter extension)

dc_avg_10_80_kw.could_fill: openev 10-80 % time; kilowatt-openev curves (estimated); fastned / owner tests (permission pending)

price_used.could_fill: none in data/sources.yaml (partner feeds / indices, Decision 004)

registrations.DE.could_fill: kba-fz10 + eea (new registrations only; no open DE fleet by model)

registrations.FR.could_fill: eea (new registrations only; no open FR fleet by model)

registrations.UK.could_fill: dft-veh fleet only (no UK row in EEA after Brexit)

generation_years.could_fill: rdw first-admission years per type approval (adapter extension); eea back years; wikidata (sparse: few car items carry dates)

backtest_epa.note: EPA label values (fueleconomy.gov, public domain): US cycles, 5-cycle adjusted. A check that WLTP-based estimates land near an independent measurement, not the launch gate (independent real-world tests, spec §5).

range.gate: median absolute error < 10% (proxy, not the launch gate)

consumption.gate: median absolute error < 10% (proxy, not the launch gate)

consumption_oos.gate: median absolute error < 10% (proxy, not the launch gate)
consumption_oos.note: Leave-one-model-out: each model's prediction uses ratios fitted without it. This is the honest error of the calibrated wltp-ratio rung on an unseen model.

backtest_popularity.note: Report only (no gate). release = generations[].popularity (T-149); reference = the web build's ranking (apps/web/src/lib/popularity.ts on data/seed/top40.yaml), same picks and weights. Spearman over generations both rank; ties take their average rank.

profile_fields.note: Report only. Ratios compare the catalogue figure with the calibrated consumption matrix (1.0 = same). The winter temperature step is unvalidated (needs winter road tests, Q-059).

dc_km_per_20min.proxy_note: No licence-clean charging test yet (real-world test sources, Q-059).

holdout.method: leave one generation out: fit on the other generations, then the visitor's path (choose_curve, kept_share on the yearly table, rounded band per variant)
holdout.error: shown median / sample median - 1 (asking prices); in_band = sample median inside the shown P25-P75
